hoodConfigurations.name: Heavy-Duty Recirculating Commercial Ventless Hood (2-Stage ESP, Dual Ionizing Cells, 1,450 CFM, UL 710B Certified)
hoodConfigurations.classification: UL 710B Category II Recirculating Exhaust System
hoodConfigurations.primaryGreaseExtractor: Double-Baffle UL 1046 Centrifugal Stainless Steel Baffle
hoodConfigurations.odorOzoneFilter: Manganese Dioxide (MnO2) Impregnated Virgin Coconut Shell Activated Carbon (65 lbs)
hoodConfigurations.fireSuppressionSystem: UL 300 Interlocked Wet Chemical Fire Extinguishing System (Ansul R-102)
hoodConfigurations.description: High-capacity recirculating ventless hood engineered for electric griddles, conveyor broilers, and double fryers in urban high-rises or leased sculleries lacking direct roof roof penetrations. Employs dual 2-stage electrostatic cells with integrated high-voltage interlocks.

hoodConfigurations.name: Compact Countertop Ventless Hood (Single 2-Stage ESP Cell, 650 CFM, UL 710B Listed)
hoodConfigurations.odorOzoneFilter: Bonded Activated Carbon & Permanganate Pellets (28 lbs)
hoodConfigurations.fireSuppressionSystem: Integral UL 300 Pre-Engineered Wet Chemical Suppression
hoodConfigurations.description: Designed for compact fast-casual stations, mall kiosks, and convenience operations over single electric countertop fryers or Panini grills. Requires frequent cell washing due to smaller collector surface area.

hoodConfigurations.name: Industrial Multi-Stage Ventless Hood with High-Flux ESP & Vacuum-UV Oxidation (2,200 CFM)
hoodConfigurations.classification: Heavy Commercial Recirculating System (UL 710B / NFPA 96 Ch 13)
hoodConfigurations.espStages: Dual High-Efficiency 2-Stage ESP (14 kV Ionizer / 7 kV Collector)
hoodConfigurations.odorOzoneFilter: Regenerable Catalytic Ozone Converter Bed (MnO2 / CuO Catalyst) + 110 lbs Carbon
hoodConfigurations.fireSuppressionSystem: Dual-Nozzle UL 300 Interlocked Wet Chemical Fire Suppression
hoodConfigurations.description: Maximum-duty recirculating system for high-throughput institutional kitchens and ghost kitchens. Pairs high-voltage electrostatic precipitation with high-output catalytic destruction, maintaining under 0.02 ppm ozone emissions even during continuous heavy searing.

hoodConfigurations.name: Unmaintained 6-Month Foul-Degraded Ventless Hood (Coated Wires, Arc-Over Faults, Saturated Carbon)
hoodConfigurations.espStages: Degraded 2-Stage ESP (Suppressed to 7.5 kV / 3.8 kV via Leakage)
hoodConfigurations.odorOzoneFilter: Saturated Spent Activated Carbon (>95% Micropore Blinded)
hoodConfigurations.description: Hazardous real-world operating condition resulting from deferred maintenance. Corona wires are coated with polymerized grease insulating the field, secondary collector plates exhibit repetitive high-voltage spark-over arcing, and saturated carbon discharges excessive ozone into the breathing zone.

applianceEffluents.name: Commercial Heavy-Duty Electric Charbroiler (High Smoke, Solid-Fat Pyrolysis)
applianceEffluents.description: One of the most challenging appliances for ventless recirculating systems. Dripping animal fat onto radiant electric heating elements causes rapid pyrolysis, producing dense blue submicron smoke aerosols (0.05 to 0.8 μm) and volatile aldehydes.

applianceEffluents.name: Dual Commercial Electric Deep Fryers (Continuous Potato & Batter Frying)
applianceEffluents.description: Continuous frying generates micro-droplets of triglyceride oil aerosols, moisture steam plumes, and free fatty acid vapors. High moisture can lead to electrical flashover across ESP cell insulators if dew point is reached.

applianceEffluents.name: Heavy-Duty Commercial Electric Griddle (Burgers, Bacon, Searing)
applianceEffluents.description: Generates substantial aerosolized animal fats and grease vapor during high-heat protein caramelization. Baffle pre-filters capture larger droplets, while the 2-stage ESP must capture fine condensable grease particulates.

applianceEffluents.name: Conveyor Sandwich Toaster & Panini Press (Light Duty Fast-Casual)
applianceEffluents.description: Light-duty commercial cooking equipment producing low grease loads but continuous bread crust volatile organic compounds and fine carbon crumb aerosols.

regulatoryStandards.title: Standard for Recirculating Systems
regulatoryStandards.keyRequirement: Mandatory interlock cutting appliance power within 5 seconds if airflow drops below 85% rated CFM, if ESP cell is absent or shorted, or if filter interlocks are breached.
regulatoryStandards.particulateLimit: Total emissions of particulate matter shall not exceed 5.0 mg/m³ as determined by EPA Method 202 testing.

regulatoryStandards.title: Recirculating Systems for Commercial Cooking Operations
regulatoryStandards.keyRequirement: Continuous mechanical interlocks on all filter access doors, static pressure differential sensors, electrostatic power supply interlocks, and automatic UL 300 fire suppression actuation.
regulatoryStandards.greaseLimit: Maximum grease deposition limit of 0.002 in. (50 μm) on internal plenum surfaces.

regulatoryStandards.title: Air Contaminants - Ozone Permissible Exposure Limit
regulatoryStandards.keyRequirement: 8-hour Time Weighted Average (TWA) PEL is 0.10 ppm (0.2 mg/m³). NIOSH recommends a ceiling of 0.10 ppm not to be exceeded at any time and 0.05 ppm for heavy physical work.

regulatoryStandards.title: Determination of Condensible Particulate Matter Emissions
regulatoryStandards.keyRequirement: Quantifies submicron condensable grease and organic vapors that escape mechanical baffle filters, requiring >95% removal via electrostatic precipitation.

failureModes.name: Corona Ionizing Wire Grease Polymerization & Field Quenching
failureModes.mechanism: Aerosolized oil droplets coat fine tungsten corona wires, increasing effective radius r0 and reducing Peek's law surface field strength, suppressing electron emission and particle charging.
failureModes.dangerLevel: High (ESP collection efficiency collapses from 98% to <50%, discharging grease smoke into room)
failureModes.symptom: Dull yellow flame or absent purple corona glow; high-voltage indicator LED dims or flashes fault.

failureModes.name: Collector Plate Dielectric Breakdown & High-Voltage Spark-Over Arcing
failureModes.mechanism: Grease thickness on secondary ground plates exceeds dielectric breakdown threshold, triggering continuous high-current electrical sparks that can ignite accumulated grease fats.
failureModes.dangerLevel: Critical (Severe fire hazard within hood plenum; potential UL 300 chemical discharge)
failureModes.symptom: Loud snapping/crackling acoustic discharge inside ESP cabinet; power supply resets repeatedly.

failureModes.name: Activated Carbon / MnO2 Ozone Decomposition Bed Saturation & Breakthrough
failureModes.mechanism: Volatile organic hydrocarbons blind the micropores of the activated carbon matrix, inhibiting the catalytic reduction 2 O3 -> 3 O2 and allowing raw ozone to spill into the kitchen.
failureModes.dangerLevel: Severe (Breathing zone ozone exceeds 0.10 ppm OSHA PEL, causing respiratory tract irritation and pulmonary inflammation)
failureModes.symptom: Sharp pungent chlorine-like odor in kitchen; eye and throat burning reported by culinary staff.

failureModes.name: Differential Pressure Sensor Clog & Cooking Appliance Lockout
failureModes.mechanism: Grease condensate clogs pitot tubes or static pressure sensing ports, triggering false airflow loss signals that shut down cooking equipment during peak service.
failureModes.dangerLevel: Moderate (Disrupts kitchen operations; tempts operators to illegally bypass UL 710B safety relays)
failureModes.symptom: Ventless hood blower runs but cooking fryers/griddles are unpowered; 'Airflow Fault' status lit.
